name: sc-numeric
componentDescription:
####Configuration Fields
| Field | Values  | Default (if not present) |  Details | 
 | ---- | ---- |  ---- |  ---- | 
 |  name  |` values `|  not-set |  description  |
####Description
What does it do?

#### Configuration Fields
| Field | Values  | Default (if not present) |  Details | 
 | ---- | ---- |  ---- |  ---- | 
 |  name  |` values `|  not-set |  description  | 
| linkText |  `string` | not-set |  The contents of "linkText" should be positioned in the header bar about 30 px from the end of the Header label in the same font. It should be styled as a http link according to the current css. This should activate the cursor change to the selection pointer when moused over. Any spacing defined in the linkText should be preserved to allow some user manipulation of the position in the header. |
| linkIcon | `material-font icon name` | not-set | | The "linkIcon" should be used to define a span class and icon entry that is displayed adjacent to the "linkText" (This is why spacing should be preserved) but if the "linkText" is not defined then the 30px offset from the header will still apply. The linkIcon should also activate the selection pointer on mouse over. |
| url | ` a url to open` | not-set | "url" defines a URL to be opened this is either relative to the current server or an absolute url with a https tag |
| overrideTemplate | `templateId` | not-set | OverrideTemplate refers to a templateId to be used on the current document as an override template by adding to the end of the current document url. |
| urlOpenIn | `currentWindow, newWindow, popup` | currentWindow | The "urlOpenIn" should support the usual values and same implementation as sc-url provides. The same default if it is not present should also apply "currentWindow". |
| allowFullBarSelection | `boolean` |  false  | if set true the any clicks in the bar should activate the panel. This excludes the current Arrow icon that is controlled with a seperate config. NOTE, this will need to avoid the icon added in 15759: Panel component with additional icon and link to open document with override template when both are in use. If not specified the default value should be false |
| allowIconSelection | `boolean` |  true | if set true then the current arrow icon will activate the panel. The default value if not specified should be true so the icon is active. |

Only one of the "url" or "overrideTemplate" can be used if both are provided the "url" shall be used and a warning logged that "overrideTemplate {{templateId}} is being ignored"


All of these are optional and if not specified then the link option will not be displayed. Either url or overrideTemplate can be used but not both!

####Description
Collapsible panels. Uses the same definitions as sc-static-html where panels would be specified (ie. wrapHtmlType:wrap). 

```
    {
            "name": "classificationPanel",
            "componentName": "sc-panel-collapse",
            "visible": true,
            "wrapHtmlType": "wrap",
            "wrapAction": "open",
            "wrapClass": "panel-A",
            "label": "Classification",
            "fullWidth": true
        },
    {
            "componentName": "sc-panel-collapse",
            "name": "classificationPanel",
            "wrapAction": "close",
            "wrapHtmlType": "wrap"
        },
```

Provides the ability to select one or more documents from a list that are loaded via an elastic query.  The documentId and name are saved in an array on the document.
